prompts.featured: Use case: stylized-concept. Original MEE editorial artwork, a premium crafted miniature of tactile paper, limestone and ceramic. No typography, numerals, labels, logos, watermark, statistical graphic or multi-panel collage. An imaginary central eastern European square miniature with a short section of plain ivory wall carefully dismantled into blocks at one edge, small orderly market stalls with cobalt and vermilion fabric roofs opening across the square, warm stone historic facades in background. Daylight, reflective rather than triumphant tone, no identifiable city, flags, writing or people. Wide 1200x630 cover.
